liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Terrapin Station** (2 reviews): Jerry sang the Inspiration vocal correctly, unlike a previous week's performance; Terrapin Station featured a surprisingly good lyrically nice and very spacey middle jam [8][12]
- **Touch Of Grey** (1 review): The band opened with a powerful Touch of Grey and a rocking follow-up [10]
- **El Paso** (1 review): El Paso was highlighted as the standout performance in the first set [11]
- **Victim Or The Crime** (1 review): Victim Or The Crime was a pleasant surprise for a Sunday show [11]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Crazy Fingers was considered the best live version of the 1994-95 era [12]
- **The Last Time** (1 review): A beautiful Spanish Jam coalesced into a fiery Last Time reading [15]
- **Attics Of My Life** (1 review): A fake out of Stella Blue occurred before the Attics Of My Life [11]

## The recordings

- **gd94-12-18.akg.ladner.13530.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 144 min; rated 3/5 by 9 [1]. Said about its sound: The audience recording captures the show well with quite nice sound quality; Drums featured strong beats with cymbal accents and variety in the era; Bobby Weir played acoustic guitar on El Paso, sounding charming and woody [10][18]
- **gd1994-12-18.akg.seff.3618.shnf**: source not stated; 18 songs; 144 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1994-12-18.149204.dts.tobin.flac16**: source not stated; 15 songs; 124 min [7]
- **gd1994-12-18.141249.FOB-NeumannKM140.ebel.flac1644**: source not stated; 18 songs; 144 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [3]

## Around the show

- LAPD helicopters hovered above the crowd, causing some disturbance during the performance [8]
- Teleprompters were used but lacked syncing to music tempo, making them worse [10]
- This recording is a vast improvement over other available sources of the show [14]
- The show is a nice companion to the very good December 16 concert [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-12-18.akg.ladner.13530.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jon Seff and Chris L.; source: Audience: AKG 460B/CK8 [1]. Also: Transferred via DA-20mkII, Hosa S/PDIF, and Delta DiO 2496 to WAV; Shntool fix applied by Chris L to the original AKG seed [1]
- **gd1994-12-18.akg.seff.3618.shnf**: transferred by Jon Seff; source: AKG 460B + CK8 > D3 @48k [2]. Also: Levels were very high at the start and adjusted at 3:03 of track 1; Tracked for three discs, though rearrangement allows fitting onto two discs [2]
- **gd1994-12-18.149204.dts.tobin.flac16**: transferred by DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix by Kevin Tobin; source: DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix [7]. Also: Mixed by an archive.org user and converted to FLAC on March 10, 2020 [7]
- **gd1994-12-18.141249.FOB-NeumannKM140.ebel.flac1644**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: flac16/44.1 Source Info: FOB Neumann KM 140-> Aerco P/S-> Casio DTR 100-> DAT.Transfer Info: Dat Tape (Panasonic SV-3700)-> Marantz CDR-615-> CD (Late… [3]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Robbi Cohn: [1994-12-16 Sports Arena, Los Angeles, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-12-16-sports-arena-los-angeles-ca-usa/) [21]
